desc: Random name lists for created/recruited generic characters. File: u32 counts[30]; u32 offsets[sum(counts)] (relative to pool start, list order); pool of NUL-terminated UTF-8 strings. Lists = 6 kinds x 5 languages (JP,EN,FR,CHN,KOR): 0-4 human male, 5-9 human female, 10-14 monster male, 15-19 monster female, 20-24 extra joke names/nicknames ("What?", "VIP", "Generic Name"; FR list only 45 entries), 25-29 extra (only 29 KOR used, 29 names). Lists are per language and NOT index-aligned (EN male starts "Dr. Klahn", JP male starts with アーカード; CHN female list has 944 entries). Pseudo-record per list entry; kind chosen by char.dat kind_gender (human/monster x male/female).

fields.name: list
fields.desc: list index 0-29 (kind*5 + language); kinds: 0 human male, 1 human female, 2 monster male, 3 monster female, 4 extra/joke names, 5 extra (KOR only)

fields.name: pool_order
fields.desc: position of the string inside the pool (kept for byte-identical rewrite; new rows: use a large number)
